scope: Lean v4.34.1 / Mathlib v4.34.1; research/ecdlp_weakness_lean_20261104/lean/SubfieldFactorBase.lean; refutes the literal all-curves reading of Joux-Vitse Assumption 1 together with the cited Hasse bound
statement: For a Weierstrass curve W over a finite field K with q elements and an extension L of odd degree, the points of W(L) that are sums of points with x-coordinate in K number at most 2q + 1.
